readiness.reason: Static review confirms an AA-level focus-management gap in modal dialogs (F-003) and missing on-air live-region announcements (F-015). No browser, axe or screen-reader run was possible, so runtime conformance is NOT_VERIFIED. Readiness is advisory only.

F-001.reason: Playlist load and state logic is outside accessibility scope; lead-verified AuthFetchError fields were not independently checked by me.

F-002.reason: Auth token refresh behaviour is outside accessibility scope.

F-003.reason: GenericModal.vue:75-81, ScheduleDialog.vue:380-386 and LiveDialog.vue:201-208 have no focus move, trap or restore. ScheduleDialog and LiveDialog have no Escape handler. This is a WCAG 2.4.3 gap. Blocker status is a separate judgement.

F-004.reason: Contradicted by App.vue:83-88, which binds htmlAttrs.lang to the locale through useHead, and main.ts:20 installs createHead. My Round A claim missed this useHead call. Only the pre-hydration default in index.html:2 remains, which is not a conformance failure.

F-005.reason: I did not check the colour values or contrast ratios for destructive buttons.

F-006.reason: Visual state styling is outside my scope and I did not check SettingsBreaks.vue.

F-007.reason: SSE and uuid fetch logic is outside accessibility scope.

F-008.reason: Config store fallback logic is outside accessibility scope.

F-009.reason: Chunked upload concurrency is outside accessibility scope.

F-010.reason: Playlist race conditions are outside accessibility scope.

F-011.reason: Media store race conditions are outside accessibility scope.

F-012.reason: frontend/src/stores/index.ts:21-27 starts a setTimeout on each msgAlert call and never clears the previous one, so an older timer hides a newer alert early. Confirmed by reading the source.

F-013.reason: Locale key coverage was not checked by me.

F-014.reason: Unsaved-change guard behaviour is outside accessibility scope.

F-015.reason: NowPanel.vue:169 and TransportBar.vue:118-145 expose on-air state without any aria-live or role=status region. Timed alerts from AlertMsg.vue are the only announcement path. This is a WCAG 4.1.3 gap.

F-016.reason: LoginView.vue:135-160 nests the show/hide button inside the password label. The compound accessible name is inferred from accname and the HTML content model, not observed in a run. Likely real; impact text should say so.

F-017.reason: Visual badge styling is outside my scope and I did not check LoggingView.vue.

F-018.reason: Contrast values for live colours were not checked by me.

F-019.reason: Token consistency is outside my scope.

F-020.reason: Responsive layout was not checked at runtime and is outside my scope.

F-021.reason: Typography sizing is outside my scope.

F-022.reason: authFetch retry behaviour is outside accessibility scope.

F-023.reason: Token storage and URL exposure are security scope, outside mine.

F-024.reason: Upload auth path is outside accessibility scope.

F-025.reason: Poller lifecycle is outside accessibility scope.

F-026.reason: Global listener lifecycle is outside accessibility scope.

F-027.reason: Type safety is outside accessibility scope.

F-029.reason: Role gating and server enforcement are outside my scope; backend evidence was not checked by me.

F-030.reason: Setup redirect logic is outside accessibility scope.

F-031.reason: UserEditor.vue:46-58 gives the password and repeat fields no aria-invalid or aria-describedby link to the error at UserEditor.vue:89. The placeholder is the only keep-password instruction. This is a LOW WCAG 3.3.1 best-practice gap.
